ssim_method: Channel-average SSIM over the union of source/render foreground pixels (alpha > 0.5), using uniform 7x7 local windows, C1=0.01^2, C2=0.03^2. Original pixel dimensions. This is a defined image-similarity check, not a guarantee of subjective equivalence.
notes: Original PNG and earlier SVGs preserved. Normalized shared colour-region edges to the original pixel-cell boundaries, removed duplicate and collinear vertices, and consolidated 128 area-weighted solid tones. Reordered closed contours spatially and shortened moves. Kept the 480 fitted gradients and the curved master silhouette. No extra tone-smoothing filter was used; the existing 0.1px seam-correction effect remains. This is still a detailed vector trace.
